seoTitle: RF Creditor Reference and Belgian OGM/VCS Generator
metaDescription: Generate ISO 11649 RF references or Belgian +++ structured communications with check digits, or verify one you have.
intro: Creates and checks RF references and Belgian structured communications.
why:
A structured reference lets the receiver match a payment to an invoice automatically. The RF format (ISO 11649) uses a mod 97 check, and the Belgian +++000/0000/00000+++ format uses the first ten digits modulo 97.

Paste an existing reference to verify it. The calculations are standard and were checked against published examples.
howTo: Choose create RF, create OGM or verify.
Enter your invoice or customer number.

faq.a: RF references have up to 21 characters after the check digits.

faq.q: What if the remainder is 0 in OGM?

faq.a: Nothing you type leaves your browser.
